title: Claude Cowork: coming to mobile and web
format_note: Feature launch told as one worked scenario (Acme QBR prep) moving from laptop to phone, with no voiceover and a music bed.
one_thing: Brief Claude once, and Cowork keeps working while you are away, then reaches you on your phone and in the browser with the finished brief.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. The caption track holds only [music] tags and two stray 'Heat.' lines that are caption errors over an instrumental bed.
transcript.script_shape: Story carried entirely by on-screen type: a headline, a typed user prompt, a typed assistant reply, status pills, a phone notification, a closing tagline and a logo.

structure.frame0: Mid-blue ground with faint white line pattern; the white serif words 'Claude keeps working,' are on screen by 0.25 s and centred (window-01). Not black, not empty.
structure.first_3s: Headline assembles word by word in 0.25 s, 'even when you're not' arrives 1.29-1.7 s, an empty white card appears at 2.0 s (f0002) and a Cowork composer starts typing by 2.6 s.

beats.what: Headline 'Claude keeps working, even when you're not' on blue ground.
Composer types a long Acme QBR brief; four zoom reframes between macro text and the full box.
'Got it.' reply, integration checks, Progress card, two Schedule task cards, cursor clicks Schedule.
Pull-back to the Cowork window inside a laptop frame, showing it is the web or desktop app.
Halftone coral cloud with floating status pills ('Search email files', 'Finishing up your ta...') while the user is away.

Chat scrolls away; tagline 'Your thinking sets the direction. Claude keeps it moving.' over the dot field.
Coral star grows, then 'Claude' types in beside it on cream; music falls silent at 78.2 s.

good.observation: The film opens on its own thesis as large type that is complete within 0.25 s, so the hook reads before the first cut at 5.0 s.
One concrete scenario (Acme QBR, named people, $240K ARR, ticket counts) runs the whole film, which proves the feature without any narration.
Abstract halftone field with floating status pills stands for the work happening while the user is away, showing absence instead of naming it.
Laptop frame and phone frame on the same patterned ground say 'web and mobile' without a caption.
Macro punch-ins make long typed text readable: line pitch 118 px at the macro frame against about 35 px in the wide composer.
A visible human edit (highlighted sentence replaced by the user's version) makes the draft feel under the user's control.

weak.observation: Master is hot: true peak +1 dBTP and -12 LUFS integrated, above the -1 dBTP ceiling and -14 LUFS target.

rule_candidates.rule: Show off-screen or waiting work as an abstract field with 2-4 blurred pills and one centred pill that types its status, instead of captioning that time has passed.

rule_candidates.rule: A calm productivity film can have no burst at all; use one three-cut punch-in cluster (here 49.71, 50.88, 51.46 s) on the reveal and let the rest breathe.
rule_candidates.evidence: metrics.json rhythm.bursts is empty; cuts 49.71, 50.88, 51.46; median shot 2.79 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Place the hero reveal on a music section return: the lock-screen notification is up by 36 s as section B returns at 35.775 s (share 0.446).
rule_candidates.evidence: f0019.jpg; audio sections B from 35.775 s; hero_moment share 0.446.

rule_candidates.rule: A one-line headline can run 7 words if it is the only element and 7.5% of frame height; build it word by word in 0.25 s so frame 0 already carries the subject.
rule_candidates.evidence: title 54 px of 720; window-01-0.042s.jpg shows words in by 0.25 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Join scenes with a moving element, not a dissolve: slide the old device out (0.25 s) as the next icon rises, or scroll the chat away to expose the tagline.
When copy is too long to read, zoom until line pitch is above 10% of frame height (118 px of 720 at f0004) and cut back to the wide shot to show the whole box.

rule_candidates.rule: Tell the proof with a named scenario carrying specific numbers and show the user's own edit to the output; specifics replace claims.

rule_candidates.rule: Keep median shot between 1.8 and 3.5 s even when single shots run long: this film's median is 2.79 s while the longest is 15.96 s.
